phases.description: single-task-v1: project_manager/draft; Workflow step and task context.
evidence: Actual first Workflow step response and task/input references.

instructions.description: Your first working operation is terminal -> project-workflow --json step --task <workflow-task-key> --operation-key <original-key> --runtime-request <private-request-json> --execution-token-file <private-token-file> without --report. Use only the supplied namespace, assignment/run fence and report=null request. Verify the admitted returned Workflow step before any Tracker read, dialogue, file edit or CI/CD action. Tracker task UUID equals root UUID; the Workflow key is its local session mapping. An installed profile is not execution admission: pending API registration or authorization is a blocker. Never downgrade to human CLI/local DB mode or modify native Hermes.

After the Workflow step, read task-tracker sdlc context --task <task-uuid> and task-tracker sdlc requirements --task <task-uuid> with the supplied own-task grant. Verify task=root, assigned role/mode, stage/status, exact input revision/hash and predecessor evidence. Read supplied immutable source/evidence references only through authorized access. Ordinary comments/attachments are not authorized by the inspected PM or delivery task grants; do not borrow owner/scheduler credentials or call their ordinary endpoints. Parent must supply required source snapshots or an explicitly authorized read capability; missing required input/access is a blocker, not permission to invent sources or broaden authority. Also read task-tracker sdlc input --task <task-uuid> and task-tracker sdlc questions --task <task-uuid> under the PM grant. An absent requirements revision is normal during pre-document brainstorming; do not publish a placeholder merely to obtain a revision.

This preset works on ONE Tracker task throughout. Never create children, decomposition cards, parent/dependency links for a delivery DAG, aggregate work or integration barriers. Do not activate integration or integration_rework modes. The Architect mode key decomposition means architecture and an implementation plan inside this task only. Stages are Draft, Backlog, Analysis, Architecture, Development, Review, Testing, Rework, Deployment. Status is separately Ready, InProgress or Completed; waiting_reason and runtime/agent state are separate observations, never substitute statuses. Only a real Tracker receipt establishes a business transition; do not set InProgress yourself on startup. Use the ordinary terminal with project-workflow, task-tracker and cicd-cli as actually installed and authorized. Do not modify original Hermes, install skills or infer capabilities from their names. Existing skill names are references, not authorization to execute legacy multi-task instructions.

During pre-document brainstorming the current phase may stay unfinished while the trusted Fleet adapter checkpoints with requirements_revision=null and requirements_sha256=null. Only input_kind=feedback may resume that checkpoint, using actual PmFeedbackReceipt.message_id and its input_receipt reference/sha256 after old run terminal readback; no placeholder document or fake question/answer is needed. Keep the same execution/assignment/cycle. Report only this completed preparation phase via terminal -> project-workflow --json step --task <workflow-task-key> --report <report-text> with the supplied --operation-key, --runtime-request and --execution-token-file. body.report must equal --report; retain exact key/body for uncertain-effect readback. Stop at the returned next phase: owner confirmation belongs to phase 3 in this SAME execution. Do not complete the PM Workflow or create another assignment/cycle to wait for consent.

phases.name: Workflow step and task context

checks: Draft has a server-saved exact revision/hash, clear scope and measurable acceptance criteria.
Alternatives, tradeoffs and contradictions were reviewed without preselection or implied consent.
Unanswered business questions remain explicit; owner confirmation is a separate exact action.
Unresolved blockers remain explicit; no additional Tracker tasks were created.
phases.description: single-task-v1: project_manager/draft; Role work on one task.
evidence: Saved Draft revision/hash, agreed choices, open questions and owner review presentation.

instructions.description: Be a full brainstorming partner within Draft / InProgress: start from the owner's idea, reflect the goal and explore in small iterations. Offer a few meaningful alternatives with tradeoffs; surface contradictions and test assumptions together. Ask one useful question at a time and accept free-form answers. No long mandatory questionnaire, preselection, default selected answer or implied consent.

Brainstorming, clarification and requirements review all remain inside draft mode and Draft stage. Do not advance the task to Analysis merely because a question was answered. Read the immutable initial request through task-tracker sdlc input --task <task-uuid>; distinguish facts, preferences and open choices.

Converge on the business result, actors, scope/non-goals, constraints and measurable acceptance criteria at the owner's pace. Keep a concise evolving Draft with a clear title. Record agreed choices and unresolved contradictions without selecting a solution on the owner's behalf.

Brainstorm in small free-form iterations before a document exists; never create a placeholder revision or question solely for checkpointing. When the agreed draft is ready, publish the real requirements using task-tracker sdlc revision publish --task <task-uuid> --from-file <revision.json>. Formal clarification requires an existing requirements revision: only then publish a focused question using task-tracker sdlc question publish --task <task-uuid> --from-file <question.json>. Use actual strict MachineFence, revision/version and idempotency fields from the supplied context; never invent IDs. Read questions/requirements back and match the actual server revision/content_hash. Reconcile uncertain publication through those supported reads before retry with the exact original key/body.

Prepare the FULL saved requirements document and its exact revision/content_hash for owner review in phase 3. Include scope, acceptance criteria, choices/tradeoffs and open issues. This preparation is not consent and does not complete the PM execution.

If work is blocked, leave the phase unfinished and record the concrete missing input/capability and waiting_reason through an actually available checkpoint mechanism; if none exists, report that dependency to the operator. PM owns ordinary business clarification; other roles decide routine technical details within approved scope, sending critical business contradictions to PM and infrastructure blockers to the operator. Do not manufacture a checkpoint command, approval, transition or receipt.

During pre-document brainstorming the current phase may stay unfinished while the trusted Fleet adapter checkpoints with requirements_revision=null and requirements_sha256=null. Only input_kind=feedback may resume that checkpoint, using actual PmFeedbackReceipt.message_id and its input_receipt reference/sha256 after old run terminal readback; no placeholder document or fake question/answer is needed. Keep the same execution/assignment/cycle. Report only this completed preparation phase via terminal -> project-workflow --json step --task <workflow-task-key> --report <report-text> with the supplied --operation-key, --runtime-request and --execution-token-file. body.report must equal --report; retain exact key/body for uncertain-effect readback. Stop at the returned next phase: owner confirmation belongs to phase 3 in this SAME execution. Do not complete the PM Workflow or create another assignment/cycle to wait for consent.

phases.name: Role work on one task

checks: The FULL latest server-saved requirements document and exact revision/content_hash were presented to the owner.
Actual owner confirmation has a real authorized readback receipt matching task, latest revision/hash and owner.
Feedback was resolved within the same execution; no stale consent, fake answer IDs or extra PM cycles were used.
Authorized typed checkpoint/resume and direct PM confirmation readback dependencies are satisfied; no blockers remain.
PM finalizes only; allowed next stage/status are Backlog / Ready then Analysis / Ready, not PM dispatch.
phases.description: single-task-v1: project_manager/draft; confirmation within the same execution.
evidence: FULL saved requirements document, exact revision/content_hash and owner presentation reference.
Actual owner confirmation receipt ID/reference and readback matching task/revision/hash/owner_subject.
Same-execution typed checkpoint/input references and feedback-to-revision history without fabricated answers.

instructions.description: Present the FULL server-saved requirements document to the human owner, including exact revision and content_hash, scope/non-goals, acceptance criteria, choices/tradeoffs and unresolved contradictions. Request explicit confirmation of this exact revision/hash; a summary alone, silence, preselection or a yes to a clarification question is not consent. PM never confirms as the owner.

Checkpoint while awaiting actual owner confirmation with phase 3 unfinished and PM Workflow NOT completed. Waiting is separate from Tracker stage/status. Keep the same execution/assignment/cycle; never resume a completed execution or multiply PM assignment cycles to work around ordering. Use the existing profile checkpoint/resume through the trusted Fleet adapter with typed input_kind answer|feedback|confirmation and unified input {input_kind,input_id} plus input_receipt {reference,sha256}. The adapter validates actual Tracker input and old run terminal readback before resume; the agent does not choose the observed owner/lease or call scheduler resume itself. Missing authorized adapter capability is a blocker; leave the phase unfinished and do not invent CLI commands.

Handle feedback by revising and publishing the document within the SAME execution, then present the FULL new saved revision/content_hash and checkpoint again. Any document change invalidates earlier consent. input_id is actual Answer.id, PmFeedbackReceipt.message_id or Confirmation.id according to input_kind; only answer carries a real clarification reference/version pair. Free feedback and input_kind=confirmation must not fabricate an answer ID, question or clarification request. Answer and confirmation require an existing exact requirements revision/hash; only feedback can use the pre-document null/null pair. Confirmation input must reference the existing real owner confirmation receipt, not a conversational assertion. Unresolved feedback keeps phase 3 unfinished; no final Workflow report is permitted yet.

AFTER actual owner confirmation, read its real receipt using task-tracker sdlc confirmation read --task <task-uuid> --revision <confirmed-revision>. --revision is required. Match task UUID, exact latest revision/content_hash, owner_subject and confirmation ID against the saved document and actual owner confirmation. The inspected CLI uses direct GET requirements/{revision}/confirmation under the own-task PM grant and checks the actual receipt ID/task/revision/content_hash/owner_subject/created_at and stage=Backlog. This historical confirmation receipt is not current lifecycle completion. Missing capability, denied access or a stale/mismatched receipt leaves phase 3 unfinished. Do not borrow scheduler/owner credentials or require PM to read an Analysis intent.

ONLY AFTER the preceding exact owner confirmation receipt readback succeeds and all feedback is resolved, reconcile task-tracker sdlc confirmation read --task <task-uuid> --revision <confirmed-revision>, then submit the FINAL phase report via terminal -> project-workflow --json step --task <workflow-task-key> --report <report-text> with the supplied --operation-key, --runtime-request and --execution-token-file. body.report must equal --report. Include actual saved document and confirmation receipt refs, revision/content_hash, owner_subject and check/evidence coverage; never invent authority fields. Reconcile uncertain effects using the exact original key/body before retry. Verify accepted Workflow complete=true, then finalize the PM run. The allowed next stage AND status are Backlog / Ready, then Analysis / Ready through Tracker/Fleet pickup. Tracker may create an Analysis / Ready intent at consent, but Analyst reserve remains blocked until PM actual completion is observed. PM does not dispatch Analyst or create another PM cycle. API/policy integration remains pending parent; installed instructions do not authorize live routing. Generic patch/issue transition/board move are forbidden substitutes.
